dataHooks.name: Default active status
dataHooks.description: Set status ACTIVE on new financial items.

dataHooks.name: Derive balance sheet role on create
dataHooks.description: Map itemType to balanceSheetRole via switch (debt → LIABILITY, investment → ASSET, default NONE).

dataHooks.name: Exclude card installment loans from liability rollup
dataHooks.description: Linked child LOAN items roll up to host card — balanceSheetRole NONE.

dataHooks.name: Exclude card installment loans on parent link
dataHooks.description: When parentFinancialItemId is set on update, force balanceSheetRole NONE.

dataHooks.name: Derive balance sheet role on type change
dataHooks.description: Re-apply balanceSheetRole when itemType changes (same switch as create).

dataHooks.name: Create initial schedule row
dataHooks.description: Seed paymentSchedule horizon from scheduleHorizonMonths (frequency-aware due dates).

dataHooks.name: Mark schedule PAID
dataHooks.description: When a transaction links paymentScheduleId, mark that schedule PAID.

dataHooks.name: Update item balance on payment
dataHooks.description: Decrease financialItem balance on PAYMENT — revolvingBalance when host card has installment children, else currentBalance.

dataHooks.name: Update account on income
dataHooks.description: Increase account.currentBalance for INCOME transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update account on expense
dataHooks.description: Decrease account.currentBalance for EXPENSE transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update account on payment
dataHooks.description: Decrease account.currentBalance for PAYMENT transactions.

dataHooks.name: Update accounts on transfer
dataHooks.description: Debit accountId and credit toAccountId for TRANSFER transactions.

dataHooks.name: Advance next due date
dataHooks.description: After payment, set financialItem.nextDueDate to earliest remaining UPCOMING schedule dueDate.

dataHooks.name: Complete one-time item on payment
dataHooks.description: When paying a ONE_TIME item, mark financialItem COMPLETED.

dataHooks.name: Sync item balance from snapshot
dataHooks.description: Copy balanceSnapshot.balance to financialItem.currentBalance.

dataHooks.name: Regenerate schedules on item update
dataHooks.description: Delete UPCOMING paymentSchedule rows when schedule fields change.

dataHooks.name: Recreate schedule on item update
dataHooks.description: Recreate paymentSchedule horizon after schedule fields change (pairs with delete hook).

dataHooks.name: Skip upcoming on pause or close
dataHooks.description: Mark UPCOMING paymentSchedule rows SKIPPED when item is PAUSED or CLOSED.

dataHooks.name: Extend schedule horizon
dataHooks.description: Monthly queued extension — top up paymentSchedule rows toward scheduleHorizonMonths.

dataHooks.name: Roll forward next schedule
dataHooks.description: After a schedule row is PAID, create the next UPCOMING row (skipped for ONE_TIME and IRREGULAR items; frequency-aware date step).

dataHooks.name: Persist inferred loan origination date
dataHooks.description: Infer originationDate for NONE/flat plans only (constant principalPortion). Skipped for FRENCH/GERMAN/AMERICAN/BULLET.

dataHooks.name: Generate loan payment plan
dataHooks.description: Monthly loan payment plan with evolving principal/interest by amortization type (hook JSON math). Full term from originationDate; mid-loan forward from currentBalance + nextDueDate.

args.value: Skipped loan payment plan — no schedule anchor (originationDate or nextDueDate). loanDetails=

dataHooks.name: Regenerate loan payment plan
dataHooks.description: Replace UPCOMING schedule rows; recomputes principal/interest via hook expressions (originationDate full plan or mid-loan forward).

args.value: Skipped loan payment plan — no schedule anchor (originationDate or nextDueDate). loanDetails=

dataHooks.name: Mark overdue schedules
dataHooks.description: Daily sweep — UPCOMING rows with dueDate before today become OVERDUE.

dataHooks.name: Cascade delete related records
dataHooks.description: Remove paymentSchedule, loanDetails, and balanceSnapshot rows when a financialItem is deleted.

dataHooks.name: Replan loan on monthly cost create
dataHooks.description: Bump loanDetails.planRevision when loanMonthlyCost create triggers loan payment plan replan.

dataHooks.name: Replan loan on monthly cost update
dataHooks.description: Bump loanDetails.planRevision when loanMonthlyCost update triggers loan payment plan replan.

dataHooks.name: Replan loan on monthly cost delete
dataHooks.description: Bump loanDetails.planRevision when loanMonthlyCost delete triggers loan payment plan replan.

dataHooks.name: Apply utilization to balance and replan
dataHooks.description: Increase financialItem.currentBalance on draw and bump loanDetails.planRevision to trigger loan payment plan replan.

dataHooks.name: Replan loan after payment
dataHooks.description: Bump loanDetails.planRevision after payment balance decrease so loan payment plan replans from live balance.

dataHooks.name: Sync card balance after installment child create
dataHooks.description: Recompute host card currentBalance = revolvingBalance + sum(child installment balances).

dataHooks.name: Sync card balance after installment child update
dataHooks.description: Recompute host card currentBalance when a linked child LOAN balance changes.

dataHooks.name: Sync card balance after revolving change
dataHooks.description: Recompute host card currentBalance when revolvingBalance changes on CREDIT_CARD.

dataHooks.name: Sync card balance after installment child delete
dataHooks.description: Recompute host card currentBalance when a linked child LOAN is removed.

dataHooks.name: Initialize card installment loan
dataHooks.description: Seed child LOAN balance from originalPrincipal and sync host card total.
